coordinatePolicy: Only WGS84 coordinates are stored in production data. GCJ-02 and BD-09 coordinates below are derived comparison coordinates, not observations returned by the providers.

routeEvidence.notes: The two OSM ferry-route endpoints coincide with the accepted water-side anchors. The route is a direct water connection and does not cross land.

providerComparison.notes: Public Amap/Baidu web search did not expose a durable exact terminal POI without interactive verification. These converted values are for future licensed-API comparison only.

terminals.decision: Move the land-side model origin west to the named OSM building footprint and rotate the terminal axis eastward toward the ferry-route endpoint. The previous land anchor was too close to the water and produced an incorrect -29 degree heading. Offset the vessel centre 16 metres into the channel so its stern meets, but does not intersect, the ramp.

providerComparison.notes: The water anchor is fixed by the mapped ferry route. The land entrance and facility footprint remain estimated because no durable exact Amap/Baidu POI or distributable building footprint was obtained.

terminals.decision: Keep the verified water-route endpoint and the east-bank approach direction, but mark the land-side facility geometry as estimated. The berth center is offset about 16 metres into the channel so the vessel stern meets the ramp without intersecting it. Do not invent a landmark roof or claim survey-grade placement.
